items.title: Germany's far-right achieves an electoral breakthrough in key state election
items.summary: Germany's populist, far-right Alternative for Germany party has declared victory in the state of Saxony-Anhalt after more than doubling its share of the vote in the first of several regional elections this fall.
items.titleZh: 德国极右翼在关键州选举中取得选举突破
items.summaryZh: 德国民粹主义极右翼政党德国另类选择党宣布在萨克森-安哈尔特州获胜，该党在今年秋天举行的几次地区选举中的第一次选举中的得票率翻了一番多。

items.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Tesla Cybercab hits the road — and a snag
items.summary: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.
items.titleZh: TechCrunch Mobility：特斯拉Cybercab上路了，但遇到了障碍
items.summaryZh: 欢迎回到TechCrunch Mobility，这是您未来交通的枢纽，现在，人工智能在其中扮演的角色比以往任何时候都更加重要。

items.summaryZh: 优步向一家刚刚聘请安东尼·莱万多夫斯基的公司投资了1亿美元。他窃取了谷歌的自动驾驶机密，让优步损失了一大笔钱，并帮助结束了特拉维斯·卡兰尼克担任首席执行官的时间。这家公司是卡兰尼克的新公司Atoms。拉夫罗斯纳·乌丁…

items.title: My Brief Summer Fling With Siri AI
items.summary: I was initially enamored with the beta version of Apple’s revamped smartphone assistant. As the full release approaches, I’ve forgotten Siri AI even exists.
items.titleZh: 我与Siri AI的短暂夏日狂欢
items.summaryZh: 我最初迷恋的是苹果改进后的智能手机助手的测试版。随着全面发布的临近，我甚至忘记了Siri AI的存在。

items.title: AI can turn a few sentences into pages of prose. Some employers have had enough.
items.summary: Fed up with bloated, confusing internal documents, companies are issuing new rules for when employees should — and shouldn't — use AI.
items.titleZh: 人工智能可以把几句话变成几页散文。一些雇主已经受够了。
items.summaryZh: 受够了臃肿、令人困惑的内部文件，公司正在发布新的规则，规定员工何时应该使用人工智能，何时不应该使用。

items.title: Restaurants have been serving up fake food ads for decades—AI slop is just the latest special
items.summary: Generative AI gives restaurants a cheap alternative to food photography, but customers may prefer an imperfect photo of a meal that actually existed.
items.titleZh: 几十年来，餐馆一直在提供虚假食品广告——人工智能垃圾只是最新的特价商品
items.summaryZh: 生成式人工智能为餐厅提供了一种廉价的食品摄影替代品，但顾客可能更喜欢实际存在的不完美的食物照片。
